Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: There lived a reindeer and a mouse. Once the mouse says: deer, let's play! You hide, (and) I will be looking for you. The reindeer said, You will not find me. The mouse: I will find you. The reindeer hid in the bushes. The mouse found him quickly. Then the mouse hid. The reindeer is [ShA:] The looking for the mouse during the whole day, his force finished. He didn't find the mouse and started eating.oblique case of force is unexpected.[ShA:] The form orojd' is not clear, middle conjugation of start is unexpected.Having not noticed that, he ate the mouse with the moss. And the mouse made hole in the reindeer'e belly and went out. The reindeer died. Since that reindeer do not play with a mouse.
